newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Eindhoven airport Jan-Jun freight up near 16 pct.
newsitem.headline: Eindhoven airport Jan-Jun freight up near 16 pct.

text.p: Eindhoven airport said it handled nearly 12,366 tonnes of cargo in the first half of the year or 15.8 percent more than in Jan-Jun last year.
The airport, in the south of the Netherlands, handled 12,141 tonnes of trucked cargo and 225 tonnes of flown cargo.
Trucked cargo volumes increased by 14 percent, up from 10,645, in the first half of 1996 whilst flown cargo jumped from just 33 tonnes carried in a single flight in 1995.
Daily trucking services operate from Eindhoven to Amsterdam, Brussels, Dusseldorf, Cologne, Frankfurt, London, Luxembourg and Paris.
Passenger numbers went up by 2.7 percent to 125,720 in the first half of 1997, compared to the same period last year. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
